mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the air sacs to blood vessels was most worthwhile: it showed oxygen and carbon dioxide crossing in opposite directions without air and blood mixing.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the branching airways was clear but predictable; the picture had already shown how the pieces fit.

surprise.text: I hadn't realized that air doesn't need to bubble into blood for gases to cross between them.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave the combinations clear purposes, though the menu already showed which pairs were compatible.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose another chapter to see how other body systems connect. Bringing breathing and circulation together was interesting.
